lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in distinct vertical columns; the spatial arrangement forms a grid with approximately 4-5 spots per vertical column in the mid-section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of lower pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature runs horizontally across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal edge and a shadow gradient below.
